title: Launch to present
blurb: Presenter app composing focus-existing launch delivery, File Handling (LaunchParams.files for .slides decks), and element.requestFullscreen(), with a Present button fallback when no activation arrives.
question: Can an already-open focus-existing presenter app read a launched .slides file from LaunchParams.files and enter fullscreen directly from launchQueue.setConsumer()?
result: On Chrome for Testing 153 (tab baselines), clicking Present entered fullscreen (document.fullscreenElement set), expired presentation rendered the fallback Present button, and the local file input parsed a 2-slide .slides deck. Installed-app file-handler and shortcut launches not verified in Chrome 160.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 153 (click fullscreen, expired fallback, and file input verified); installed-app launch not verified in Chrome 160

friction.summary: Web App File Handling (LaunchParams.files) is desktop-only and requires a one-time OS/browser file-open approval
friction.repro: Install the presenter on Chrome for Android and attempt to open a .slides file via LaunchParams.files; Android Chrome has no web-app file handlers.
friction.browser: Chrome for Android (desktop-only File Handling API)
friction.workaround: Provide a standard <input type="file"> loader alongside LaunchParams.files and show an explicit Present button whenever navigator.userActivation.isActive is false.
